newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nara Banking Corp sets US$40 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Nara Banking Corp sets US$40 mln FRCD.

text.p: The following issue was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER NARA BANKING CORP
AMOUNT US$40 MLN COUPON 6ML+50BP MATURITY 3 YRS
TYPE FRCD ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCH 05.DEC.96
PUTS ANNUAL** CALLS NONE REPLIES 20.DEC.96

RATING -- SALE LMTS STANDARD TAX PROV FREE & CLEAR
NEG PLG -- CRS DEF -- FORCE MAJ IPMA2
HOME CTRY S.KOREA GOV LAW ENGLISH PAY DATE LATE JAN.97
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
CO-LEAD MANAGERS US$4 MLN 54 BP ALL-IN 68
CO-MANAGERS US$2-3 MLN 51 BP ALL-IN 67
ARRANGERS BANKGESELLSCHAFT BERLIN GROUP, CITICORP
INTERNATIONAL, CS FIRST BOSTON (HONG KONG) AND KEB
(ASIA) FINANCE (PAYING AGENT)
NOTES **FRCDS CAN BE REDEEMED AT 99.62 ON THE FIRST
ANNIVERSARY AND AT 99.81 ON THE SECOND ANNIVERSARY.
OWNERSHIP COVENANT: CS FIRST BOSTON (EUROPE) AG, AND
THE JS KIM FAMILY WILL RETAIN AT LEAST 19 PCT AND 13
PCT, RESPECTIVELY, DIRECT OWNERSHIP IN ALL THE THE
ISSUED SHARES OF THE ISSUER THROUGHOUT THE LIFE OF

THE ISSUE HAS BEEN FULLY UNDERWRITTEN BY THE
ARRANGERS. CLEARING THROUGH EUROCLEAR OR CEDEL
SIGNING IS SCHEDULED FOR MID-JANUARY 1997
